value.answer: There's no open Costco in Oakville yet. The first one is going up on Wyecroft Road near Burloak Drive, with fall 2027 as the target opening. The closest open ones are Burlington at 1225 Brant St and Mississauga at 3180 Laird Rd. Heads up, today is Thanksgiving and Apple Maps had the Burlington one closed, so it may be shut today.
